svg.title: Beer Launcher wiring (block level)
svg.text: ESP32-C3 SuperMini · BTS7960 (IBT-2) · 37GB555 12 V · 2 x MG996R · pins from firmware/launcher/src/hal_esp32.cpp · see PINMAP.md / WIRING.md
+12V_PROT rail · 1.0 mm² TB1 → bridge; 0.5 mm² to buck / beacon
GND rail · 1.0 mm² (all returns meet at TB1)
GPIO3 → ENC_A (interrupt, both edges) · 0.14 mm² · JST-XH 4p, encoder on 3V3
microswitch NO, COM→GND · LOW = arm on fwd stop
microswitch NO · LOW = at cocked angle
NO: pin INSERTED = closed = LOW = safe
LM393 open-collector DO, LOW = can seen
LM393 DO, LOW = can in cup
1k REQUIRED: GPIO21 is U0TXD at boot
BAT54 blocks the module's 5 V pull-up; 10k to 3V3 gives the HIGH; LOW ≈ 0.5 V (< 0.8 V VIL).
brown GND · red V+ · orange SIG
V+ via safety pin pole B
• TB1 is the only point where the 12 V return, buck return and logic GND join (star ground).
• R2/R3 10k pull-downs keep the bridge off while the ESP32 is in reset/flashing (EN pins are tied high).
• IBT-2 logic VCC from 3V3 so its input buffer accepts 3.3 V levels; R_IS/L_IS unused.
• D2 1N5819 across a magnetic buzzer (cathode to +12V); not needed for a piezo / LED-only beacon.
• Safety pin = one actuator, two contacts: pole A to GPIO7 (NO), pole B in latch-servo V+ (NC).
• Debounce 100 nF on GPIO4/5/6/7 only. No cap on GPIO9 (strap) or GPIO3 (encoder).
• Flash over USB with the 12 V brick unplugged: GPIO2's pull-up switches the beeper on in download mode.
